content.title: How much is the Masters Tournament purse? What to know for 2026
content.text: Winning a Masters Tournament comes with plenty of prestige. The iconic green jacket, a gold medal and a trophy that depicts the Augusta National Clubhouse are just some of the perks that come with winning the competition. And, of course, a healthy amount of money -- the higher one finishes, the better. Last year, Rory McIlroy collected $4.2 million from the $21 million purse, a total that increased by $1 million from the 2024 figure. Here's what to know about the total purse in 2026: MORE MASTERS COVERAGE When is the 2026 Masters Tournament? The 2026 tournament ran from Thursday, April 9 to Sunday, April 12. What is the total purse for the 2026 Masters Tournament? The total purse number for 2026 is $22.5 million. This is a $1.5 million increase from the 2025 tournament. How much does the winner of the 2026 Masters Tournament get? Rory McIlroy will take home $4.5 million as the winner. Scottie Scheffler will earn $2.43 million for second place, while third place receives $1.53 million, as four golfers tied for that spot (Russell Henley, Cameron Young, Justin Rose and Tyrrell Hatton.) The top 39 finishers this year will earn at least $101,250, while the 50th-place finisher receives $56,700. Players who miss the 36‑hole cut still take home $25,000. The full breakdown is here. How much was the first Masters Tournament purse? Before it was called the Masters, the tournament was named the "Augusta National Invitation Tournament." Horton Smith won the first ever edition in 1934 and claimed a prize of $1,500. Who has won the most Masters Tournaments? American golfer Jack Nicklaus has won the most Masters Tournaments with six. The years he won were 1963, 1965, 1966, 1972, 1975 and 1986. Tiger Woods, who did not compete this year, is second with five wins (1997, 2001, 2002, 2005, 2019). 1:045 things to know about Augusta National Golf Club Here are five things you should know about Augusta National, home of the Masters Tournament.
